verdict.comment: Preference is for the resurgent 8yo POP DANCER (nap) who has won two of his last three including a dominant display over C&D last time.

comments.bigtimerascal: Caused a surprise with his breakthrough win here latest; up 2lb on this drop back in trip
comments.gogoyubari: Finished down the field in five runs this season and latest was at Doncaster on Saturday
comments.merrimack: Course winner and he's reached the frame in four of his five runs this season; in the mix
comments.popdancer: Has won two of his last three and it was a dominant display over C&D latest; key player
comments.rebelstar: Won at Yarmouth in April and was runner-up behind Pop Dancer over C&D latest; dangerous
comments.silkyrobin: Won here in April; two fair efforts since but needs to find something extra back in trip

races.raceComment: popdancer is marginally preferred with a score of 47.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over rebelstar. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 4 wins from 19 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: Most of these have lots to prove but IREZUMI won here last summer and he's caught the eye with his strong finishes over C&D recently.

comments.edvardgrieg: 15-race maiden who has struggled last twice and is untried beyond 1m2f; passed over
comments.fascinatinglips: On long losing run but he's not beaten far in last two runs; in the mix after short break
comments.foinix: C&D winner but he's lost his way and needs a major revival
comments.fullforward: C&D winner but he's been well held in last three runs and needs to turn things around
comments.goodeye: Unexposed 4yo but he's struggled in both handicaps and needs a transformation back on turf
comments.irezumi: Eyecatcher in C&D handicaps last twice and he's respected back in a classified event
comments.jamesparkwoods: Just two wins from 51 starts and he often misses the break; others preferred
comments.mond: In sharp decline since leaving Andre Fabre and has lots to prove at this new trip
comments.skimmingalong: Unexposed gelding and he's a possible improver upped in trip with headgear added
comments.starofjupiter: Sole win was at 50-1 on AW and he needs another bolt from the blue

races.raceComment: fullforward is marginally preferred with a score of 50.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over irezumi. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Top of the list is DARYSINA GOLD, who went close over C&D last Monday and is a big player if she can repeat that form.

comments.blenheimstar: Had an excuse over 1m2f latest and she won over C&D on penultimate run; interesting
comments.buythedip: Dual C&D winner who returned to form with a close second here ten days ago; respected
comments.cubangirl: Unexposed filly; caught the eye at Salisbury and is a possible improver at this new trip
comments.darvel: Justified favouritism on seasonal return at Bath but he's been well held in two runs since
comments.darysinagold: Back to form with a close call off this mark over C&D last Monday; big player
comments.inittogether: Four AW wins but he's yet to score on turf and was well held here ten days ago
comments.nobleguest: 0-9 but was good second behind an improver at Lingfield (7.6f) last Saturday; respected
comments.rulingmaster: 0-8 and he struggled in final three runs for Marco Botti; plenty to prove for new yard

races.raceComment: buythedip is marginally preferred with a score of 60.7%, holding clear edges in superior course form over blenheimstar. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 19 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include strong course form, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for TIME PATROL who made it 3-3 at Brighton when completing a course hat-trick ten days ago. Zu Run is feared most.

comments.binthavanagold: Solid record this year and she's respected back up in trip
comments.cooperation: Won over 7f at Newmarket last month but was disappointing at Chepstow next time
comments.kracking: Made all here in April but he's been well held in three runs since; down the list
comments.marshbenham: Four-time course winner and has possibilities if this sets up for his closing style
comments.teasea: Unexposed on turf and has claims if he can transfer his AW form back to this sphere
comments.tigercrusade: Just one win in last 27 months and he's never run here before; others preferred
comments.timepatrol: Five wins from last seven starts including here in last three runs; big player again
comments.twirler: Dual AW winner who is unexposed on turf but needs to find something extra; headgear on
comments.undercurfew: All nine wins have been at spring trips and this is competitive back up in grade
comments.zurun: Emphatic win over C&D last month; up 6lb but he's a major player again

races.raceComment: timepatrol is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over zurun. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 5 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to BEAR TO DREAM, who won a classified event over C&D last Monday and is on an unchanged mark back in a handicap.

comments.barnsnapeboy: 0-13 but wasn't beaten far here last time and looks worth another try at this trip
comments.beartodream: Won classified over C&D latest; on unchanged mark and big player again back in a handicap
comments.comedianleader: In-form 5yo and has claims if she gets a good pace on this drop back in trip
comments.eightmile: On dangerous mark but he's been out of sorts for new yard this spring; plenty to prove
comments.falmouthboy: 12-race maiden and he struggled in his final five runs last season; passed over
comments.kranjcar: Two turf wins in April and had an excuse on AW latest; dangerous back in this sphere
comments.poeticforce: Prolific winner who has reached the frame here in his last three runs; in the mix
comments.riverwharfe: Triple C&D winner who forced a dead-heat over 1m here latest; respected up 3lb
comments.romanemperor: On much-reduced mark and respectable efforts here last twice but he needs to find more
comments.spiritcharmer: Seven-race maiden and has plenty to prove for new yard after 226 days off; hood added

races.raceComment: beartodream is marginally preferred with a score of 59.9%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 4 wins from 20 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.cabezadellave: C&D winner on a fair mark; yet to find his form this time around though
comments.dapperling: Ready win from off the pace at Goodwood on Friday; inconsistent but can't ignore her
comments.exquisement: Three heavy defeats over further for new yard; dropped 14lb; risky
comments.hkfourteen: Form took off last autumn, winning three in nine days; promising return; not fully exposed
comments.havechatma: On a good mark but better on AW and only sixth over C&D two weeks ago; others stronger
comments.secrethandsheikh: Went close over C&D in April; unlucky in running at Chepstow latest; fair mark; chance
comments.sergeantmayer: Thriving this year; bumped into handicap blot latest; up 4lb but still a strong contender

races.raceComment: cabezadellave is marginally preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in more progressive over hkfourteen. Won 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: This may go to a newcomer, with Hassaleh, \bCountry Artiste and DICTAL all making plenty of appeal.

comments.countryartiste: 50,000gns half-sister to two winners; strong paper claims; betting to guide
comments.dictal: Fine pedigree and yard's 2yos have made a fine start; plenty of paper appeal

comments.hassaleh: Has some smart winning siblings and dam was high-class; stable rich in 2yo talent

comments.misskim: Dam unraced daughter of 1,000 Guineas winner Miss France; others appeal more on pedigree
comments.priestess: 11,000gns sister to two winners; others bring more compelling paper claims
comments.saramoon: Bred to be sharp but Bella Lyra may be the stable's chief hope
comments.selmiya: Outpaced on recent AW debut but did shape with promise; open to improvement

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Regal Envoy and Woolhampton can go well but LAW OF AVERAGE may not have reached his ceiling and could take some pegging back.

comments.adrestia: Two 5f wins as a 2yo and the Sandown form is strong; absent 282 days; market useful
comments.changesings: Progressive sprinter; good efforts in defeat in 2025; creeping up weights; down in trip
comments.fidelius: Yet to win on turf but has run to a similar level as on AW (three wins); stable run three
comments.jakajaro: Has some smart sprint form; down in grade for return to Britain; holds a Group 1 entry
comments.lawofaverage: Giant strides last year; stiff task on reappearance; big chance granted good or faster
comments.michaelasboy: Two AW wins around the turn of the year; held form since until down the field in the Dash
comments.miraculous: Unexposed 3yo; gelded since last run (pulled hard over 7f); betting useful on h'cap debut
comments.missattitude: Latest York fifth was better but she'll need a step forward to take this
comments.regalenvoy: Sprinter on the up, winning two of his last three; goes well here and for Oisin Murphy
comments.rosario: Got up late to win at Goodwood last month; weakened over 6f latest; others better treated
comments.woolhampton: Conditions to suit and latest C&D 5th threatened a revival; one to be interested in

races.raceComment: regalenvoy is marginally preferred with a score of 57.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over lawofaverage. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 11/36 at windsor. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

horses.name: manfromhavana
horses.owner: P J & Mrs J P Haycock

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: Nine of the declarations have run but they have not accomplished much. MAGICAL IDEA is tentatively preferred.

comments.almekarem: Kingman half-brother to winners including Wuqood (6.7f-1m; RPR 107); a newcomer to note
comments.beautybeyond: Both runs (1m, AW) showed some ability and she's one to consider
comments.christmasgift: Never dangerous on either start; among the best form claims, albeit at an unexciting level
comments.henrytheninth: Major work to do after 7f novice events last July and 12 days ago
comments.karthala: Showed bit of promise over C&D (good to firm) in May; wide draw at Kempton (7f, AW) latest
comments.magicalidea: 6-1, made most when last of six in novice at Lingfield (1m2f, AW); should improve
comments.manfromhavana: Late foal by Havana Grey; others are more persuasive on paper
comments.pakal: Towards rear at Kempton (1m, AW; favourite) in October and Nottingham (1m, good) month ago
comments.platinumbabe: 100-1 at Leicester (1m, good to soft) 13 days ago and faded into a remote last of ten
comments.shirazi: 40-1, beaten 14l at Leicester (1m, good to soft) but did at least pass three of her rivals
comments.soholegend: Twice slowly away and always behind; likely to come into his own in handicaps over further
comments.versaillesprince: Brother to 1m-11.6f winner Miss Dolly Rocker (RPR 85); hooded; needs a second look

races.raceComment: karthala is marginally preferred with a score of 18.5%, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

horses.name: silentstorm
horses.owner: J Kimber, J Savory, A O'Callaghan

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: Much stronger race than the first division. ACCENTUATE finished with a flourish to be second over 7f at Newbury and looks the standout.

comments.accentuate: Placed both starts, strong finish latest; 1m can help; he looks sure to win something soon
comments.bellaspath: 65,000euros breeze-up 2yo by Zarak; hooded on debut in a pretty warm race
comments.dissident: Among the market leaders for both starts and no shock if he has a major role to play here
comments.furhaan: 70,000gns yearling by Showcasing; probably needs to be good to win this on debut
comments.holysmoker: 5th in November (8.6f, AW); 10th of 14 at Kempton (1m2f, AW) makes this look tough, though
comments.marmaladekid: 80-1, slowly away and no show at Kempton (7f, AW) 19 days ago
comments.mawood: 25-1, raced wide when beaten 26l in rear at Chelmsford (1m, AW) 18 days ago; cheekpieces
comments.muhaajim: Midfield at Newmarket (1m) but seventh of ten at Southwell (1m, AW; 7-2) 11 days later
comments.pebbleisland: Showed much more last time (four ran) but longer trips may well be his thing
comments.silentstorm: 22-1, outpaced over 2f out at Newbury (7f, good) last month but rallied into fourth of 11
comments.zouligan: Looks one for further down the line after two runs this year, latest last Tuesday

races.raceComment: accentuate is marginally preferred with a score of 21.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over dissident. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Boy George would look the most likely winner on several counts but a chance is taken that ALPINE STROLL can repeat his 2024 revival.

comments.alpinestroll: Tailed off on return but Rossa Ryan is booked and this 7yo is one to keep an eye on
comments.boygeorge: 2-2 in Windsor handicaps; did it well on Chepstow return; looks sure to have a big shout
comments.carpkid: Veteran who shaped well on reappearance but all his turf wins were on good or good to firm
comments.fihrayn: 0-14 for Richard Hannon; no show when trying 1m4f on stable debut ten days ago
comments.kentuckykingdom: Three 1m2f wins under Joe Leavy in the second half of 2023; absent since that December
comments.lawnranger: 10yo who is 5-15 at Windsor, yet he hasn't raced here since August 2023; stamina to prove
comments.lusaka: Last four wins were over 1m6f; he's been out of form and blinkers replace cheekpieces
comments.moonlitcloud: Recent reappearance was more positive again but she is unraced beyond 1m3f
comments.mrembo: All four wins on good or firmer and it's possible she needs that; latest start was one
comments.naasma: C&D winner; form dipped when favourite on latest outing but she's probably a contender
comments.nowhere: Ten-race maiden, all on AW; pretty consistent, stays 1m4f and edging down the weights
comments.oceanheights: Quickfire double off career-low mark under Jack Dace on good to firm over 1m4f/1m2f

races.raceComment: oceanheights is marginally preferred with a score of 49.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings over mrembo. Won 2 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: There are alternatives but QUEEN OF STEEL has the wind in her sails and can defy an 11lb hike for winning so well at Nottingham.

comments.bodygroove: Hurdle winner in March; no impression back on the Flat at Carlisle three weeks ago (1m6f)
comments.captainpotter: Beaten a head and a close fourth on his last two runs; should be involved
comments.destinationunkown: Possible improvement up in trip for handicap debut but perhaps wishful thinking
comments.differentdrum: Entitled to run a lot better than he did on the AW only nine days ago
comments.fabuleuxduclos: Won twice over hurdles in 2023 but has regressed since returning from an absence
comments.forglen: Has done quite well in handicaps since undergoing wind surgery; each-way claims
comments.queenofsteel: On a roll for current yard, winning twice over hurdles before strolling home at Nottingham
comments.quercusrobur: Bit disappointing last time at Catterick but was a 2m5f winner here the run before
comments.teamendeavour: Showed no form over hurdles before finishing tailed off back on the Flat at Carlisle
comments.triplenickle: Appreciated returning to the Flat when running well for a 50-1 chance at Wolverhampton
comments.yakhabar: Laboured effort here 17 days ago when the 1m4f was no excuse

races.raceComment: triplenickle is marginally preferred with a score of 53.9%. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: With a combined record of 5-6 over C&D, KEEP WARM and Sir Maxi are particularly interesting returned to this scenario.

comments.admirald: Poor strike-rate since 2022 but now drops in grade; similar type to Illusionist
comments.danzan: Well held last time; this veteran drops in class but is on a two-year losing spell
comments.havanagila: This step back up to 6f is worth exploring; well treated on best 2yo form
comments.illusionist: Poor strike-rate over the last three years but this is a drop in class; not ruled out
comments.keepwarm: 2-2 in 6f handicaps, both wins at Pontefract in July 2023; interesting back here
comments.larchilllass: Quite an exposed 3yo; first-time hood needs to make a difference
comments.minnesotalad: Modest strike-rate but shaped encouragingly last time and remains on a handy mark
comments.onenightthunder: Chance depends on how well he responds to this drop in distance
comments.sirmaxi: Has form figures of 1121 over this C&D, the most recent performance off 4lb higher
comments.speedingbullet: Generally regressive since 2yo win; drops back to 6f for first time since debut
comments.willolarupi: Won at Redcar last time, taking record over 6f to 2-5; still unexposed at this trip

races.raceComment: sirmaxi is confidently preferred with a score of 59.6%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged due to uphill finish and tight turns

verdict.comment: With a combined record of 5-7 at Pontefract, the most interesting contenders are PROFITEER, Loving Apprentice and May Blossom.

comments.alreetcha: Inconsistent since her sole win and has enough to prove in this scenario
comments.biplane: Ran poorly returned to turf last time; yet to defy a mark this high; opposed
comments.fierce: Two wins for previous yard; form figures of 244 this season for new yard; solid chance
comments.ineedyourlove: Form dipped sharply (something possibly amiss) over C&D in sole run this term
comments.latearrival: Three wins last term but has failed to show his form in two runs this season
comments.lovingapprentice: Clearcut success in C&D maiden on final 2yo start; interesting back in this scenario
comments.mayblossom: Steadily finding her form this season; 2-4 at Pontefract and 3lb below last winning mark
comments.misterskyblue: May resume progress back down in distance; 6f winner on penultimate outing
comments.profiteer: Two from two at Pontefract; ran encouragingly at Redcar most recently; respected
comments.redmirage: Shapes as if this belated drop back to 6f won't be an issue; on a handy mark
comments.thegoodbiscuit: Encouraging form this term for new stable; possibilities dropped in grade

races.raceComment: profiteer is marginally preferred with a score of 49.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over mayblossom. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
